name: tree-valen-cache-train
description: Cache Valen train processor features (30k) for Stage 1
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish
V=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii
M=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/models/Qwen3.5-4B

export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1

export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

rm -rf "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/tree/valen_cache_train"

"/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/.venv-sii/bin/python" -m treejev.cache_valen_features --jsonl "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/tree/valen_split/train_visual.jsonl" --model "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare/models/Qwen3.5-4B" --output "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/runs/tree/valen_cache_train" --chunk-size 1000 > "/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/multichoice_publish/logs/qz/tree-valen-cache-train.log" 2>&1
status=$?; echo "JOB EXIT=$status"; exit $status
